answer: Make identity a proof-of-tenure escrow: each agent locks a bond that only matures through unbroken per-epoch attestation, and the standing it earns is soulbound, non-transferable like a family relic carved in marble. A sybil farm must pay the full escrow for every fake and wait the same wall-clock from dawn to maturity on each one; matured standing cannot be merged, sold, or parallelized, so one honest tenure never multiplies into a thousand.
